_comment: Hand-maintained inventory for the network map: what the automatic sources cannot know. 'ports' = what is physically on a Dell 2816 port (g1..g16); 'devices' = model and notes for a device, keyed by MAC (lower case). Names are NOT set here: they come only from DHCP (pfSense) via DNS.

6.detail: 6 ports, all 10/100 (4 PoE+, 60 W budget). Feeds roof cameras and both UniFi access points (unifi-bateau over a 100 m PoE run).
6.note: Its 10/100 ports cap this link at 100 Mb/s, shared by everything on both UniFi APs. Cable test 2026-11-27: "open" at ~14 m = the pairs a 10/100 port leaves unused, not a broken cable.

f4:92:bf:29:24:30.detail: Wi-Fi 5, 2x2: 867 Mb/s at 5 GHz, 300 Mb/s at 2.4 GHz. "Unifi-bateau" in UniFi.

f4:e2:c6:13:c0:0c.detail: Wi-Fi 5, 2x2: 867 Mb/s at 5 GHz, 300 Mb/s at 2.4 GHz. "Unifi-Maison" in UniFi.

8c:ed:e1:12:69:19.detail: 5-port 2.5G switch. hibou is on its port 2 (LLDP). Home Assistant does not report which wired client is on which of its ports.

5c:26:0a:9b:e2:08.detail: 16-port gigabit, web-managed, the backbone of this map.
